objective: Correct current v1 native ontology and quality standards, implement verifiable collection and complete project acceptance, and re-extract real project assets while preserving history.
approvalSource: User confirmed the complete reviewed plan in the originating conversation; private source and evidence bindings are retained separately.

Native Rego v1, OPA and Conftest with pinned configuration and mandatory cases
Correct specifications/v1 in place; identify normative content by owner standardDigest

Expert forward/reverse and public/private journeys with real Codex verification
Fresh reverse extraction from fixed source snapshots and substantive second-round validation

targets.intent: Freeze scope, repository bindings and all criterion variants
Prove isolated upstream toolchain and minimum actual collection/run/recovery
Implement native standards, owned lifecycle, strict composition, Expert and packaging
Independently re-extract and verify two real source rounds with historical protection
Verify installed user journeys, native independent replay and all pre-release variants

completion.preRelease: All fixed pre-release variants require actual exact-candidate evidence
completion.postRelease: Published download/install readback and final closure remain pending until executed
completion.requiredResults: Complete fixed set, no missing, skipped, unknown, unsupported or stale required result
completion.negativeCases: Passing a negative test means the specified rejection occurred
completion.authority: Technical results cannot fabricate human domain decisions

preservation: Old commits, tags, releases, audit, asset deliveries, decisions and receipts retain exact bytes
Business source and releases remain unchanged; private project evidence stays private
No new tasks under the defective historical validator; historical readback only
Current canonical contracts and generated vendor copies are corrected together by the parent producer
exclusions: Second real-project onboarding and v1.0 release
Production database, deployment or online SLO execution
Automatic background synchronization, approval or warning-driven releases
New repository or service, own SHACL/Rego interpreter, unrestricted executor
Changes to frozen historical governance or archived sources
